The Frostwolf First-Fang is a fang from a frost wolf named Longhowl. Longhowl's owner, Karash, was wearing it the day he met his beloved, Magra. When Karash sent a Dog-Eared Note to her, he included the fang as a token of his affection. This item is found in the Frozen Envelope Magra has clutched to her chest. It can be combined with the Snow Hare's Foot to create Talisman of Yearning Unfulfilled.

Frostwall is the Horde Garrison, located in Frostfire Ridge. A fully-upgraded Frostwall garrison is considered to be a fortress. The Alliance counterpart is Lunarfall, located in . Following the end of the war in Draenor, the garrison was abandoned.

The Frostfire Ridge storyline is the Horde starting experience in Frostfire Ridge after getting through Warlords of Draenor intro experience. Here, players quickly set up their Garrison at Frostwall in the south-center portion of the zone, then work to help shore up the Frostwolf clan's defenses. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement You'll Get Caught Up In The... Frostfire! In addition to the overarching zone storyline, a huge number of vignettes can also be found all over Frostfire Ridge. These vignettes are one-time events: killing rare or rare-elite mobs, finding out-of-the-way treasure chests, or small events like fending off waves of attackers.

__NOTOC__ Frostfire Gronnlings are gronnlings found at Frostwall before adventurers establish their garrison. The progeny of the gronn Skog, these beasts are impeding Gazlowe and his workers in their building of the garrison, and he asks that they be dealt with. Some of them can be found carrying Icehoof Calves, which struggle to wiggle free of their captors' grips. Notable among these gronnlings are Gruuk and Gurun.

Frostwall Mines is available to Horde players upon upgrading the garrison to level 2. After completing Things Are Not Goren Our Way (Horde), Frostwall Mines will unlock and be given to the player for free. It allows you to gather Draenor Ores and Draenic Stone once a day, which are used for work orders to gain more Draenor ores. A level 1 mine grants 8 deposits, level 2 grants ~13 deposits, level 3 grants ~18 deposits. The Alliance equivalent is the Lunarfall Excavation.

Froststone Vault is the north-central anchor location of Forbidden Reach. The Froststone Vault Primal Storm event takes place here, marked by an elemental skull on the zone map. The area is bordered by the Froststone Peak to the north, Hornswog Grounds to the east, Stormsunder Crater to the southeast, the Old Weyrn Grounds to the south, and the Lost Atheneum to the southwest. The Forbidden Hoard occasionally spawns at southeast of the vault entrance at the spring that feeds the river, guarded by three Tarasek Plunderers.

The Frosted Spine is the snow-covered southern highlands of southern Forbidden Reach. The spine is bordered by the Old Weyrn Grounds to the north, the Talonlords' Perch to the northeast, the Broken Seaboard to the southeast and south, the Sharpscale Coast to the southwest, Morqut Islet offshore to the west, and the Aerie Chasm and Skyfox Den to the northwest. A Dragon Glyph is located at and the Trial of Storms and Storm-Bound Chest event takes place just uphill at . The rare proto-dragon Galakhad spawns at in the southwestern part of the spine, but despite what the map suggests, Warden Entrix is instead in the War Creche micro-dungeon (accessed from the Old Weyern Grounds). Fungal monsters are fungus-like creatures found on both Azeroth, Outland, and Argus. They closely resemble bog beasts. Loatheb is an undead fungal monster. He was the hideous result of fusing the living plague of the Plaguelands with the bog beasts of Azeroth. He can be found at the end of the Plague Quarter in Naxxramas. The mirebeasts of the Wetlands are symptoms of the earth's disturbance, a foulness of rot given form. They take the shape of bog beasts, infested within with decaying spores, forcing out flourished life in the swamp taking all and leaving only rot.

Fungal Giants are fungal giants found in Quagg Ridge, Zangarmarsh. When you kill a Fungal Giant or a Bog Lord will you gain +15 reputation with Sporeggar. No reputation is given once Revered is reached.

Frozen Rune is a high level consumable found within Naxxramas. Though a consumable, it is primarily used as both a crafting reagent and quest objective for the Argent Dawn frost resistance items. Crafting an item with a Frozen Rune required being near the Icebellow Furnace.

Fungal Rock is a large cavern in the northeastern wall of Un'Goro Crater. The cavern is filled with gorillas, which have made their home, and Ghost Mushrooms. Outside the entrance is a small pool of water with a waterfall, this is where A-Me 01, Karna Remtravel's mechanical ape can be found.

The Fungal Vale is one of the most corrupted areas of the Eastern Plaguelands, where the Plague of Undeath has taken a strong hold over the land. The ground is a dark purple and the Vale is filled with a murky haze. The Fungal Vale is infested with members of the Scourge and the Cult of the Damned, at levels 40-41. The Vale is found north of the Marris Stead and Crown Guard Tower.
Frostwolf Village is the stronghold of Horde General Drek'Thar, located in the southern part of Alterac Valley.

A location in Azeroth, perhaps Northrend. The four-leaf clover is seen as an omen of good luck. However for heroes who venture into this clover's heart too soon, all the luck in the world will avail them nothing.
Fruit are sweet and fleshy seedpods, and are one of the main types of food in WoW.

Fungal horrors are bog beasts gone bad. They are enormous fungal masses composed of unyielding vegetable matter held together by dirt and foul tempers. This creature resembles an enormous, animated mound of fungus, filth and other detritus. White-spotted toadstools protrude from its mass. Four thick tentacles sway in the air as the creature lurches forward. Fungal horrors make their lairs in dank, fungus-infested environs in Outland, posing a threat to all who enter their domains. They are often found in temperate marshes or underground. Though their tactics are straightforward and predictable, they can absorb a frightening amount of punishment before dropping. The entry chamber to the Frozen Halls instances has been designated a sanctuary and can be found on the northwest side of the citadel on the upper parapet. A meeting stone can be found inside the halls near the three instance lines. Every loot item which drops in both Normal and Heroic modes for those instances is of epic quality. The loot for Normal mode equals or surpasses 10-man Ulduar drops in some slots. A full clear of an instance occurs when all trash and bosses, including those which are optional, have been killed. A full clear is often desired by persons who are grinding faction reputation gains, such as through Championing. It should be noted that in an end-game PvE raid setting, the term full clear might be applied if all raid bosses have been killed, even if some optional trash remains. By contrast, a partial clear implies some trash or bosses have not been killed. In the context of a dungeon setting, this usually means optional mobs have been skipped. Fruit of All Evil is an achievement earned by defeating the High Botanist Tel'arn encounter in the Nighthold instance while all members of the raid possess the Arcane Exposure debuff, on Normal difficulty or higher. A minimum of ten players are required in Normal or Heroic, or a full raid of twenty in Mythic. The debuff is obtained by consuming Mysterious Fruit located around the area of the encounter, around the local vegetation. Doing this grants the debuff, which is removed by either leaving the area or dying.
